models_evaluated: Epic Systems LLM-based hospital course drafting tool

links.outcome: Rubric-rated quality of LLM-drafted vs human-written discharge summaries on same hospitalizations
links.effect: LLM summaries outperformed human summaries across all nine criteria (p < .05); comprehensiveness median 0.62 vs -0.23. LLM performance was consistent across medical and surgical services.
links.quote: LLM-generated summaries outperformed human-written summaries across all criteria (p < .05), with the greatest difference observed in comprehensiveness (LLM median 0.62 vs. human -0.23).

screen.reason: Retrospectively evaluates the quality of hospital discharge summaries generated by an LLM tool (Epic Systems) compared to human-written summaries without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
